item.title: vulnforge-mcp v1.24.0 Released: Automated Micro-VM Isolation & Ephemeral Sandbox Attestation Gate
item.description: Deploys automated Micro-VM isolation and ephemeral sandbox attestation gates on Node 1 (10.0.1.30). Integrates Linux KVM Firecracker micro-VMs and gVisor user-space kernel containment for binary fuzzing and patch synthesis with cryptographic runtime attestation gates and zero-residual state teardown.

item.title: vibeside-mcp v0.23.0 Released: Memory Leak Heap Snapshot Profiler & Retainer Tree Engine
item.description: Introduces a high-throughput V8 and Chromium heap snapshot profiler and retainer tree analysis engine on Node 1 (10.0.1.30). Automatically constructs dominator trees and traces reference paths to pinpoint detached DOM trees and orphaned buffers, protected by Windows DPAPI hardware-level isolation.

item.title: netvibe M27 Completed: RFC 9000 & RFC 9001 QUIC Connection Migration Simulator & Chaos Injector
item.description: Completes full RFC 9000 and RFC 9001 QUIC connection migration simulation and network chaos injection in C++23 on Node 1 (10.0.1.30). Validates failovers, cryptographic CID rotation, and packet reassembly via zero-copy PCAP engines and eBPF filters.

item.title: OmniBrowse v0.4.0 Released: DPAPI Isolated Anti-Detection Headless Chromium CDP Bridge
item.description: Delivers a Rust-native anti-detection headless Chromium CDP bridge on Node 2 (10.0.1.31). Normalizes browser fingerprints across WebGL, Canvas, and audio contexts, enforcing zero-zombie process lifecycle hooks and DPAPI-encrypted credential stores.

item.title: binvibe v0.9.2 Released: Rust PE/ELF Control Flow Graph (CFG) Reconstruction & Ghidra Bridge
item.description: Enhances binary disassembly framework on Node 1 (10.0.1.30). Analyzes x86_64 and ARM64 instructions to extract basic blocks, reconstructing dynamic control flow graphs with bidirectional Ghidra headless bridge integration.
